title: DeJig: McKnight: Art Collection
native_title: デジグ マックナイト ～アート・コレクション～
overview: DeJig: McKnight Art Collection is a digital jigsaw puzzle game and part of the DeJig series. The game includes 20 different puzzles featuring the works of painter Thomas McKnight, which come in 72-piece and 108-piece difficulty levels. Pieces can be rotated and will lock into place when placed correctly, and the completed image can be viewed at any time as a reference. Completing each puzzle will unlock a high-quality version of that painting for view in a gallery mode.
